intro: A ticket machine buzzes like it knows you.

legal_actions.label: Buy Ticket
legal_actions.summary: Buy the ticket. It was decided at the press.

intro: A pull-tab rack waits by the counter.

legal_actions.label: Buy Ticket
legal_actions.summary: Pick a row. The ticket drops into your stack.

cheat_actions.label: Peek / Scan
cheat_actions.summary: Peek without a detector for a risky 50/50 read, or toggle an owned detector safely.

intro: The reels hum, hungry and polite.

slot_generation.formula: formats * families * math_variants * bonus_variants; visual adds cabinets

legal_actions.label: Spin
legal_actions.summary: Spin at the bet you picked.

cheat_actions.label: Nudge
cheat_actions.summary: Nudge a near miss into a small bonus.

intro: The cup hits leather like a threat.

legal_actions.label: Roll
legal_actions.summary: Ante the pot, shake up to three times, lock 6-5-4, then beat the table's cargo.

cheat_actions.label: Loaded Toss
cheat_actions.summary: Force the Ship, Captain, or Crew face you need. Draws heat if anyone looks.

cheat_actions.label: Palmed Swap
cheat_actions.summary: Find the weak die and time one swap. A bad palm draws heat anyway.

intro: The dealer taps felt. Your turn to sweat.
description: Beat twenty-one without being worth watching.

legal_actions.label: Play Hand
legal_actions.summary: Hit, stand, split, or double. Naturals pay 3:2.

cheat_actions.label: Peek Hole Card
cheat_actions.summary: Steal a look at the dealer's down card. Watchful tables cost you.

cheat_actions.label: Count Cards
cheat_actions.summary: Run a Hi-Lo check and update the count you carry.

intro: The shoe waits with expensive patience.
description: Bet banker, player, or bad instinct.

legal_actions.label: Deal
legal_actions.summary: Back Player, Banker, Tie, or pairs before the croupier deals.

cheat_actions.label: Read Shoe
cheat_actions.summary: Memorize the dealer's shoe cues to earn a read. Mistakes draw heat.

cheat_actions.label: Edge Sort
cheat_actions.summary: Track card-back cues across hands for a short edge. Getting caught draws heat.

intro: The stickperson offers the dice with professional patience.
description: Set the point, work numbers, command the rail.

legal_actions.label: Roll Dice
legal_actions.summary: Place line, Come, Odds, Place, or Field wagers before the throw.

cheat_actions.label: Set Dice
cheat_actions.summary: Use the practiced release window to bias, never fix, the throw.

cheat_actions.label: Switch Dice
cheat_actions.summary: Measure and switch the pair under the cup before the house sees it.

patron_lines: The rail answers the point with a courteous roar.
The table leans toward the shooter without losing its manners.
Even the quiet patrons have begun to count the points aloud.

pass_line.note: Come-out naturals and craps, then point before seven.

dont_pass.note: Twelve pushes; otherwise the inverse line wager.

come.note: Pass-line rules beginning after a point is on.

dont_come.note: Don't-pass rules beginning after a point is on.

odds.note: Free odds pay exact mathematical odds with no house edge.

place_4_10.note: Nine-to-five profit; the wager remains working after a hit.

place_5_9.note: Seven-to-five profit; the wager remains working after a hit.

place_6_8.note: Seven-to-six profit; the wager remains working after a hit.

field.note: Single roll; two pays double and twelve pays triple.

lines: Line cash on Pass if you ride with the shooter; Don't Pass if you ride with seven.
First throw sets a number unless seven or eleven pays Pass, or two, three, twelve cuts it.
Once a point lands, it has to repeat before seven. Pick your side and call the dice.

disperse.message: Blue light catches the brick. The circle breaks and every unresolved stake goes back at face value.

training.completion_line: The circle nods at your release. You can carry that touch to a casino table.

intro: The wheel spins. Chips pray in public.

legal_actions.label: Spin
legal_actions.summary: Lay chips across the layout, then let the wheel decide.

cheat_actions.label: Read Wheel
cheat_actions.summary: Time the rotor read to reveal this table's hidden skew. A failed read adds 20 Heat.

cheat_actions.label: Past-Post
cheat_actions.summary: Slide one chip after the ball settles. Timing pays. Getting caught costs more.

intro: The back-room table keeps the stakes small and the cards honest.
description: Friendly five-card draw: bet, draw, bet, showdown.

legal_actions.label: Ante & Deal
legal_actions.summary: Ante cash, deal five, bet once, draw once, and bet once more.

intro: A candy-lit cabinet hums for decisions.
description: Hold, draw, and bet your nerve.

legal_actions.label: Draw
legal_actions.summary: Hold what you want, draw the rest. Jacks or better pays.

cheat_actions.label: Mark Holds
cheat_actions.summary: Palm one ideal card into the draw. It draws heat.

intro: Two shelves shove a pile somebody else started.
description: Aim. Read the shelves. Walk the alarm line.

legal_actions.label: Drop Quarter
legal_actions.summary: Pick a lane and drop on the shelf beat.

cheat_actions.label: Nudge
cheat_actions.summary: Choose tap, shove, or slam; aim left, right, or front. The cabinet warns before it bites.

scenario_reset_contract.meaning: Someone else played it; replace the persisted pile once per token.
